sections.content: szeretnétek is the second-person plural conditional of szeret -- 'would you (all) like'. The conditional mood in Hungarian is built by inserting -né-/-ná- before the personal ending, softening a request into an invitation.

items.english: Would you like an activity together?

sections.content: Compare szerettek (you all like, plain present) with szeretnétek (you all would like, conditional) -- the extra -né- is what turns a statement into a polite invitation.
